create_continuous_bernoulli: create a ContinuousBernoulli distribution with probs or logits parameters
sample_continuous_bernoulli: sample from a ContinuousBernoulli distribution with an optional sample_shape
compute_log_prob_continuous_bernoulli: compute the log probability of a value under a ContinuousBernoulli distribution
get_continuous_bernoulli_mean: get the mean of a ContinuousBernoulli distribution
get_continuous_bernoulli_variance: get the variance of a ContinuousBernoulli distribution
